docs/CONTRACT.md:56:Incident closure requires stated recovery criteria, a successful applicable evaluation of the affected elements, observed result evidence and recorded authority/action. Merely attaching a failed check does not close an incident. G3/G4 must test failing/missing/expired/environment-mismatched evaluations, source tampering, dependency change, stale rollback and unsuccessful incident verification as well as passing paths.
